text: Based on the data, trees were cut down on this property after 2020. The Global Forest Change dataset (Hansen/UMD) indicates that there was tree cover in the year 2000, while the European Commission Joint Research Centre's Global Forest Cover 2020 (GFC2020) dataset shows that there was no forest in 2020. This suggests that the trees were removed between 2000 and 2020. Since the baseline date for the analysis is December 31, 2020, and there is no forest cover recorded in 2020, it confirms that the trees were cut down after 2020.
